name: prose
title: Prose
description: The article-body wrapper. Renders an `<article>` whose descendants (`h1`–`h6`, `p`, `a`, `ul`/`ol`/`li`, `blockquote`, `figure`/`figcaption`, `code`/`pre`, `table`, `img`) get DS-token-mapped typography without per-element class gymnastics in the consumer.…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/prose

Installed to `components/ui/prose.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/prose';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/prose

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
